verdict.rationale: Bruno explicitly documents keeping credentials out of version control via secret variables and vaults (bruno-docs-33), and offers concrete external vault integrations like Azure Key Vault CLI authentication (bruno-docs-34) and GCP Secret Manager support (bruno-docs-17/26). This directly matches the platform-engineer's need to avoid storing secrets in shared files. Missing for 10: broader vault provider coverage (e.g. AWS/HashiCorp Vault) documented, and independent/community verification of secret masking behavior in practice.
